entries.fc3b398f08dc4b1f: Under its management philosophy, 'Provide products and services that enrich and make homes and daily life comfortable, and contribute to improving the cultural life of local communities,' it operates multiple businesses, including outdoor specialty stores, built around its core Home Center Business; its basic policy is to remain a 'Chiiki Ichiban-ten' (local number one store) loved by local communities, with the slogan 'a store that is safe, kind and convenient for customers.' In its medium- to long-term strategy, its basic approach is to deepen regional dominance in the Home Center Business, pursue specialization at WILD-1, a nationwide outdoor business, and fully leverage its 'unique business portfolio' combining these with the Specialty Store Business, in order to build a profit base over the medium to long term that is highly resilient to changes in the business environment.
